operations.description: This API is used to associate a queue with an elastic resource pool.
This API is used to bind a queue to a created enhanced datasource connection.
Adding Resource Tags in Batches
This API is used to delete jobs in any status in batches.
This API is used to delete scheduled CU changes in batches.
Deleting Resource Tags in Batches
This API is used to delete SQL templates in batches.
This API is used to run Flink jobs in batches.
This API is used to stop running Flink jobs in batches.
This API is used to cancel a batch processing job.
This API is used to cancel a submitted job. If a job has completed or fails to be executed, the job cannot be canceled.
This API is used to check the SQL syntax.
Querying the Number of Resource Instances
This API is used to create datasource authentication.
This API is used to send an address connectivity test request to a specified cluster, and insert the test address into the table.
This API is used to create a data mask strategy and anonymize the SQL execution result.
This API is used for data mask strategy authorization.
This API is used to add a database.

This API is used to create a basic datasource connection with other services. For details about how to use the console interface, see Basic Datasource Connections. Datasource connections cannot be created for the default queue.
This API is used to create a DLI agency.
This API is used to create an elastic resource pool.
This API is used to create an enhanced datasource connection with other services.
This API is used to create a datasource route.
This API is used to create user-defined jobs, which currently support the JAR format and run in exclusive clusters.
This API is used to submit a stream SQL job in JSON format using the POST method.
This API is used to generate a static stream graph for a Flink SQL job.
This API is used to create a Flink job template. A maximum of 100 Flink job templates can be created.
This API is used to create global variables. Global variables are used to replace sensitive data in SQL jobs.
This API is used to create an IEF message channel.
This API is used to report IEF system events.
This API is used to create cross-source authentication.
Creating a Yearly/Monthly Elastic Resource Pool
Interface for Placing an Order for Changing the Specifications of a Yearly/Monthly Elastic Resource Pool
This API is used to create a queue. The queue will be bound to specified compute resources.
This API is used to create a scheduled CU change for a specified queue.
This API is used to add new queue property.
This API is used to create a cross-source route.
This API is used to create a batch processing job in a queue.
This API is used to create a job template.

This API is used to submit jobs to a queue using SQL statements. The job types support DDL, DCL, IMPORT, QUERY, and INSERT. Functions of IMPORT are the same as that of importing data. The difference lies in the implementation method.
This API is used to create an SQL job defend rule to intercept SQL statements that match the rule.
This API is used to store specified SQL statements for reuse.
This API is used to create a table.
This API is used to delete datasource authentication information.
This API is used to delete a data mask strategy.
This API is used to delete an empty database. If there are tables in the database to be deleted, delete all tables first.
This API is used to delete a created basic datasource connection. The connection that is being created cannot be deleted.
This API is used to delete an elastic resource pool.
This API is used to delete an enhanced datasource connection.
This API is used to delete a datasource route.
This API is used to delete a job in any status.
This API is used to delete a Flink job template. The template can be deleted even if it is being used by a job.
This API is used to delete global variables.
This API is used to delete cross-source authentication information.
This API is used to delete resource packages in a group in a project.
This API is used to delete a specified queue. If a task is being executed in a specified queue, the queue cannot be deleted.
This API is used to delete a scheduled CU change for a queue with a specified ID.
This API is used to delete queue property
This API is used to delete a cross-source route.
This API is used to delete SQL job defend rule.
This API is used to delete a specified table.
This API is used to unbind a queue from an enhanced datasource connection.
Triggering a Flink Job Savepoint
This API is used to export a Flink job with a POST request. The request body is in JSON format.
This API is used to export results returned from the query using SQL statements to OBS. Only the query result of QUERY jobs can be exported.
This API is used to export results returned from the query using SQL statements to OBS. Only the query result of QUERY jobs can be exported.
Importing a Flink Job Savepoint
This API is used to import a Flink job with a POST request. The request body is in JSON format.
This API is used to import data from a file to a DLI or OBS table. Currently, only OBS data can be imported to a DLI or OBS table.
This API is used to query datasource authentication information.
This API is used to view the permissions granted to a user.
Obtain all catalog information of a project.
This API is used to obtain data mask strategies in batches.
This API is used to query names of all users who can use a specified queue.
This API is used to query the information about all the databases.
This API is used to query the list of created basic datasource connections.
This API is used to querying the queue to which an elastic resource pool belongs.
This API is used to query historical scaling records of an elastic resource pool.
This API is used to querying all elastic resource pools.
This API is used to query the list of created enhanced datasource connections.

This API is used to query the list of the current user's jobs. You can set the job ID as the ID and query jobs whose IDs are greater than or less than the ID. You can also query jobs in specific status, for example, in running status or other. By default, all jobs are queried.
This API is used to query Flink job templates. Currently, only user-defined templates can be queried.
This API is used to query the global variable list.
This API is used to query cross-source authentication information.
This API is used to view all resources in a project, including groups.
This API is used to query the scheduled CU changes and list the changes of a specified queue.
list queue properties
This API is used to query names of all users who can use a specified queue.
This API is used to list all queues under the project.
Querying the Resource Instance List
Querying Tags of a Specified Resource Type
This API is used to query the job template list.
This API is used to obtain the list of batch processing jobs in a queue of a project.
This API is used to obtain SQL job defend rules in batches.
This API is used to obtain SQL job defend rules preset in the system.
This API is used to view all SQL templates saved by a user.
This API is used to query information about all jobs in the current project.
This API is used to query all sample SQL templates.
This API is used to query the permission of a specified user on a table.
This API is used to query users who have permission to access the specified table or column in the table.
This API is used to query information about tables that meet the filtering criteria or all the tables in the specified database.

This API is used to view the job execution result after a job is executed using SQL query statements. Currently, you can only query execution results of jobs of the QUERY type. You can view the first 1,000 result records only. To view all result records, export them first.
This API is used to preview the first ten rows of a table.
This API is used to share a specific queue with other users. You can grant users with the permission to use the specified queue or revoke the permission.
This API is used to grant DLI the permission to access OBS buckets for saving job checkpoints and run logs.
This API is used to grant, revoke, or update DLI resource permissions granted to users or projects.

This API is used to create information about the metadata catalog (CATALOG) that binds or unbinds DLI to services such as lakeformation,  including the DLI CATALOG name, external CATALOG name, and type. The type is reserved. Currently, only lakeformation is supported.

This API is used to grant database or table data usage permission to specified users. The user group containing the authorized user must have the Tenant Guest permission in the region to which the user group belongs.
This API is used to process the action callback information of an IEF Flink job.
This API is used to restart, scale out, and scale in queues.
This API is used to query DLI catalog details.
This API is used to query the connectivity test result after the test is submitted.
Obtaining a data mask strategy
This API is used to obtain data mask strategy permission.
This API is used to query a created basic datasource connection.
This API is used to obtain DLI agency information.
This API is used to query the created enhanced datasource connections.
This API is used to query the authorization about an enhanced datasource connection.
This API is used to view details about a Flink job.
This API is used to query the execution plan of a Flink job.
This API is used to query monitoring information about Flink jobs. Monitoring information about multiple Flink jobs can be queried at the same time.
This API is used to view resource information of a package group in a project.
This API is used to list details of a specific queue in a project.
This API is used to get user quota information list
Querying the Tag Information of a Specified Resource Instance
This API is used to query details about a batch processing job based on the job ID.
This API is used to query the back-end logs of batch processing jobs.
This API is used to obtain the execution status of a batch processing job.
This API is used to obtain a job template.
This API is used to obtain a single SQL job defend rule.
This API is used to query details about jobs, including databasename, tablename, file size, and export mode.

This API is used to obtain the job execution progress. If a job is being executed, information about its subjobs can be obtained. If a job has just started or has ended, information about its subjobs cannot be obtained.
This API is used to query the status of a submitted job.
This API is used to obtain SQL job defend rule preset in the system.
This API is used to describe metadata information in the specified table.
This API is used to update datasource authentication information.
This API is used to data mask strategy and anonymize the SQL execution result.
This API is used to modify the owner of a database.
This API is used to modify elastic resource pool information.
This API is used to set scaling policy of a specified queue in an elastic resource pool.
This API is used to modify the host information specified in an enhanced datasource connection. Only full overwriting is supported.
This API is used to update user-defined jobs, which currently support the Jar format and run in exclusive clusters.
This API is used to process the reported information about the Flink job status on the edge.
This API is used to update a SQL job.
This API is used to update an existing Flink job template.
This API is used to modify global variables.
This API is used to update cross-source authentication information.
This API is used to change the owner of a program package.

This API is used to modify the CIDR block of the queues using the yearly/monthly packages. If the queue whose CIDR block is to be modified has jobs that are being submitted or running, or the queue has been bound to enhanced datasource connections, the CIDR block cannot be modified.
This API is used to modify a scheduled CU change for a queue with a specified ID.
This API is used to update queue property
This API is used to modify a job template.
This API is used to update SQL job defend rule and intercept SQL statement that matches the rule.
This API is used to update a SQL template.
This API is used to modify the owner of a table.
This API is used to upload a group of File packages to a project. When a file package group with the same name is uploaded, the new group overwrites the old group.
This API is used to upload a group of JAR packages to a project. When a package group with the same name is uploaded, the new group overwrites the old group.
This API is used to upload a package group to a project.
This API is used to upload a group of PyFile packages to a project. When a pyfile package group with the same name is uploaded, the new group overwrites the old group.
